speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The bed is too soft, son. A feather argues with a back. The floor will tell you the truth, if you let it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the floor. A blanket under me, and something at the knees, or I shall seize up like a hinge.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: A folded blanket, and the bolster under the knees. Stay where you are put.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: My mother's making. It is bay, and it is not a miracle, and it will keep the skin from the blanket. Hold still.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: You are welcome, son. If you turn, you will make a noise you would cut from any play. So do not turn to show me you can.
